tool: Qucs-S transcalc (transmission line calculator), Coplanar waveguide
method: Human runs the transcalc tool of Qucs-S (GUI), component "Coplanar" (the public man page lists "Coplanar"; whether the dialog offers a grounded, conductor-backed variant is NOT known to us: run the two qucs-cpwg-* cases only if it does, otherwise leave them null and write so here). Qucs-S model names are not documented publicly (ledger S-028a). Record in this field: exact Qucs-S version, OS, field names and meanings (in particular whether the dialog's spacing is the gap on each side of the strip and whether it takes a ground width), the names and selected entries of every model drop-down (thickness, dispersion), displayed digits and every non-default setting. T = 0 (our cores model zero thickness) and frequency 1 MHz. Outputs to copy: Z0_ohm = characteristic impedance shown; eps_eff = effective permittivity shown. Every toolOutputs value stays null until a human copies it from a real run of the tool (all displayed digits, no rounding, no conversion). Quasi-static comparison: frequency 1 MHz (1e6 Hz) in the tool; if it refuses, use the lowest accepted frequency and write it here. Dielectric loss tangent, conductor resistivity and roughness do not affect Z0 or eps_eff in the quasi-static model: leave them at the tool defaults and record the defaults here. Dispersion: check the tool's settings, turn dispersion off if it can be turned off, otherwise record that it is on. Soldermask or cover/top-dielectric correction: disable it (or leave the top height at its no-cover default) and record the setting. Thickness: the t0 cases need T = 0 in the tool (if refused, enter the smallest accepted value and record it); the t35um cases need T = 0.035 mm; one tool run with T = 0.035 mm feeds the three t35um cases of the same geometry (none, A, B): copy the same displayed numbers into all three. Record the tool's exact name for its thickness and dispersion models. Details, field entries per case and the digits check: docs/validation/crosscheck-impedance.md. Agreement never verifies a ledger row; no third-party source is copied.

compare.why: Z0, CPW without a lower ground plane (ledger S-023 CONFLICT: two eps_e models, our conformal-map finite-substrate form against the empirical Steer fit stated accurate to 1.5 % for h/s >= 1). Derived before any run: eps_e may differ by 2 x 1.5 % = 3.0 % between two models, which moves Z0 (proportional to 1/sqrt(eps_e)) by 1.5 %, + 0.07 % prefactor (eta0/4 against 30 pi) + 0.02 % rounding = 1.59 %, set to 2 %. The tool is run at T = 0 so no thickness correction applies. A miss is a model-difference item (S-023), not necessarily a bug. Display-rounding term assumes the tool shows at least 2 decimals for ohm values and at least 3 decimals for eps_eff; the worksheet (section 3) requires the human to check the shown digits and re-derive this tolerance BEFORE the first run if fewer are shown.

eps_eff, CPW without a lower ground plane (ledger S-023 CONFLICT: two eps_e models). Derived before any run: 2 x 1.5 % (Steer quotes 1.5 % for its fit; two different models can differ by twice that) = 3 %. A miss is classified against S-023 (CONFLICT), not as a bug, once the tool's model is recorded.
